title: Navigate stable and freshly authorized Command Work Queue pages
goal: Replace inaccessible after-first-50 Command records with a bounded, revocation-safe, same-route read-only cursor while preserving existing six views, host ACL and current filter/sort/selection.
invariants: Exact existing six system views and ONE host-authenticated GET /command/work-queue route.
Per-request fresh trusted SessionResolver, bounded Owner.List and per-object Owner.CanRead precede filtering/sorting and any page selection; no cursor grants access.
A cursor binds to the full currently authorized bounded ordered row snapshot plus principal/tenant/environment/view/filter/order; invalid/revoked/stale snapshot is generically unavailable.
Only 50 rows emitted per page, at most 5000 owner candidates; raw owner/denied IDs never enter cursor; HTML next and first-page links retain scope-neutral status/sort/view.
Presentation cursor is NOT an authenticated cryptographic signature, production paging scheme, transactional snapshot, Shared Saved View, Inspector or host IAM.
Parent PR #164 HEAD 75981f08712978cf5f0555cad7639f37b3439486 frozen for L2; it is Git dependency only, NOT engineering parent.
security_properties: Reject malformed, duplicate, oversized cursors and client scope injection before host/session lookup.
Re-run owner ACLs for every in-scope Incident and Task on EVERY page; any owner error yields no rows.
On denied/revoked/cross-principal/tenant/context or owner revision, stale token returns generic 404 and no partial projection.
A selected row must exist on the currently authorized selected page; HTML IDs remain contextually escaped and no sensitive data in cursor.

migration.rationale: Opt-in opaque page cursor and omitempty JSON fields; no durable schema or client authority

rollback.strategy: Remove cursor codec/new page fields and restore bounded first-50 rendering while retaining existing queue authorization
verification: Previous six views, filters, sort, selected rows, freshness stay unchanged

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 complete §§1–27; Command Work Queue catalog and canonical pagination contract; full final cursor schema remains open.

outputs: Read-only opt-in second/subsequent pages, limited to currently authorized 50 visible rows, with safe next cursor and first page return on same route.
Generic fail-closed revocation and stale-context error without new authorization or pagination datastore.
acceptance_tests: 123 authorized rows + denied and cross-tenant rows paginate as 50/50/23 with unique stable ordering and no unpermitted source references.
Every page fresh host session and all current source per-object ACLs; revoked owner changes invalidate cursor without partial data.
Selection only current page; invalid/duplicated/malformed cursor denied before session/owner; stale cursor 404, no privilege from token.
Browser same-route next/first navigation preserves filter/sort and contextually escapes source values; existing pre-page JSON shape for <=50 preserved.
Exact SHA Ubuntu/macOS/Windows work queue tests and mandatory engineering-kernel checks including unchanged security-critical 90% floor.

performance_budget.rationale: One existing bounded full owner read and O(n) digest per page; no additional calls, <=5000 authorized rows, first 50 displayed.
metrics: Exactly one Owner.List and existing per-object CanRead per page
O(n) bounded JSON+SHA256 over <=5000 authorized Row projections
